summary: A Scotch Plains resident was approached through LinkedIn and WhatsApp with a cryptocurrency investment opportunity after scammers used the victims professional background to tailor their approach. The victim ultimately transferred funds for purported crypto investments and lost 120000 dollars.
user_mistake: trusted an unsolicited investment contact who moved communication to private messaging
prevention: Independently verify the identity and company of investment contacts before transferring funds / Stop sending funds when an investment contact requests personal deposits
